We visited this restaurant almost 10years ago & hoped the standard would be the same. Food was disappointingly quite average.

Aug 2019 • Couples
This restaurant was like waking back in time, the music being played by the live band was truly awful, and with only 2 other tables being occupied in this huge restaurant the ambience was non existent.
There were more non smiling staff then customers, and we waited a long time for our food to arrive, when it did it certainly was nothing special and certainly not up to the standard of nearby street food that would have cost a fraction of what we paid.
We would not return.

Very Poor
Nov 2018 • Couples
We arrived late in Saigon and this place just around the corner from the hotel reviewed reasonably well on TA so we booked a table. Starter of spring rolls was OK, mains of pork and sea bass were inedible. Tasteless, chewy, devoid of any of the flavours and freshness that we have grown to love from good Vietnamese food. The bill was shockingly high for such a poor meal. The jazz band and dancers at least provided some entertainment but without doubt this is the worse meal we have had in our time in Vietnam.

Beautiful Restaurant
Nov 2017 • Couples
I love this restaurant, it has full of potentials . The interior is superb it has an ambiance of maxims paris with hint of asia. They have cultural show that makes it very classy .. They have delicious authentic asian food. The service is not professional but super sweet and polite waiters. Perhaps the management should be careful with the details of the restaurant then this can be the best restaurant of Saigon. We had fun here and Will come back again if ever we are back in the city.

Great Traditional Lunch
Jun 2017 • Couples
Was great catching our breath inside the well air-conditioned restaurant and relaxing with a beer in hand. Our first meal in Saigon was here. We had to experience Vietnamese food and were not disappointed. The waiter was very helpful and following his suggestions we had a great variety of traditional and typical Vietnamese dishes to taste and enjoy. Every thing was perfect. Good demonstrations on holding and folding food ingredients in rice-papers and veggie leafs to get a feel for authentic eating. Food was fresh and the meat dishes very tasty. At first I was shocked to see that our bill came to 7 figures but, as the shock wore of and realised the bill was obviously charged in DONG and not in my counties currency. Shooo :) Still laughing about it. Unforgettable lunch. Recommended restaurant.
